outcome: Surgical ligation for patent ductus arteriosus
cohort: 176 very-low-birth-weight infants (VLBWIs) admitted to a NICU from 2009 to 2014.
finding: Hyperferritinemia was associated with surgical ligation for patent ductus arteriosus, sepsis, and moderate or severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia in very-low-birth-weight infants, and was correlated with aspartate transaminase, creatine kinase, and C-reactive protein.
